runtimeJs.name: web-llm-0.2.84-qwen-m5-prompt-lookup.js
runtimeJs.role: Hash-verified WebLLM ESM runtime with prompt-lookup speculative decoding and forked verify-pass replay for recurrent-state safety on Qwen3.5.

modelWasm.name: qwen35-4b-argmax-chunk256-sg32-tr32.wasm
modelWasm.role: Qwen3.5-4B model library with subgroup-32 and chunk-256 two-stage full-vocabulary GPU argmax. WebGPU GEMV TR is a no-op for this model (byte-identical compiled output at every TR value 16/32/64/128), so no TR is functionally distinguished; the filename keeps its build-time -tr32 label for traceability.

modelResources.name: mlc-ai/Qwen3.5-4B-q4f16_1-MLC snapshot
modelResources.role: Immutable upstream weights, tokenizer and MLC chat configuration

notes: The prompt-lookup runtime JS is shared by immutable URL and hash across this entry and the Qwen3.5-0.8B prompt-lookup entry; one published object is referenced from both manifests without duplication. Quality caveat: output is not byte-identical in general, because batch-verify prefill kernels and decode GEMV kernels differ in low bits and can flip near-tie argmaxes on a few percent of items. Family byte-identical verification corpus result for this entry: 10/10 corpus cases byte-identical, verified 2026-09-10 with scripts/verify-webllm.mjs against this branch's raw entry URL (verification/verify-pl5.json).
